entries.title: Jeremiah 29:1
segments: ¶And these are the words of the letter that the prophet Jeremiah sent from Jerusalem to the residue of the elders of the captivity, and to the priests, and to the prophets, and to all the people whom Nebuchadnezzar had carried away captive from Jerusalem to Babylon

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:2
segments: (after that Jeconiah the king, and the queen, and the eunuchs, the princes of Judah and Jerusalem, and the craftsmen, and the smiths, had departed from Jerusalem);

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:3
segments: by the hand of Elasah the son of Shaphan, and Gemariah the son of Hilkijah (whom Zedekiah king of Judah sent to Babylon, unto Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon), saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:4
segments: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, unto all the captivity, whom I have caused to be carried away from Jerusalem unto Babylon:

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:5
segments: Build houses, and dwell in them, and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:6
segments: Take wives, and beget sons and daughters; and take wives for your sons, and give your daughters to husbands, that they may bear sons and daughters; and multiply there, and be not diminished.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:7
segments: And seek the peace of the city whither I have caused you to be carried away captive, and pray unto Jehovah for it: for in the peace thereof shall ye have peace.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:8
segments: ¶For thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel: Let not your prophets that are in your midst, nor your diviners deceive you, neither hearken to your dreams, which ye like to dream.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:9
segments: For they prophesy falsely unto you in my name: I have not sent them, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:10
segments: For thus saith Jehovah: When seventy years shall be accomplished for Babylon I will visit you, and perform my good word toward you, in bringing you back to this place.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:11
segments: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith Jehovah, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you in your latter end a hope.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:12
segments: And ye shall call upon me, and ye shall go and pray unto me, and I will hearken unto you;

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:13
segments: and ye shall seek me and find me, for ye shall search for me with all your heart,

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:14
segments: and I will be found of you, saith Jehovah. And I will turn your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith Jehovah; and I will bring you again into the place whence I have caused you to be carried away captive.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:15
segments: ¶If ye say, Jehovah hath raised us up prophets in Babylon;

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:16
segments: yea, thus saith Jehovah concerning the king that sitteth upon the throne of David, and concerning all the people that dwell in this city, your brethren that are not gone forth with you into captivity;

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:17
segments: thus saith Jehovah of hosts: Behold, I will send against them the sword, the famine, and the pestilence, and will make them like the vile figs, that cannot be eaten for badness.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:18
segments: And I will pursue them with the sword, with the famine, and with the pestilence, and will give them over to be driven hither and thither into all the kingdoms of the earth, to be an execration, and an astonishment, and a hissing, and a reproach, among all the nations whither I will drive them:

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:19
segments: because they have not hearkened to my words, saith Jehovah, wherewith I sent unto them my servants the prophets, rising early and sending; but ye have not hearkened, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:20
segments: But ye, all ye of the captivity, whom I have sent from Jerusalem to Babylon, hear the word of Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:21
segments: Thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, concerning Ahab the son of Kolaiah, and concerning Zedekiah the son of Maaseiah, who prophesy falsehood unto you in my name: Behold, I will give them into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall smite them before your eyes.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:22
segments: And of them shall be taken up a curse by all the captivity of Judah that are in Babylon, saying, Jehovah make thee like Zedekiah and like Ahab, whom the king of Babylon roasted in the fire;

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:23
segments: because they have committed infamy in Israel, and have committed adultery with their neighbours' wives, and have spoken words of falsehood in my name, which I had not commanded them: and I [am] he that knoweth, and [am] witness, saith Jehovah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:24
segments: ¶And thou shalt speak to Shemaiah the Nehelamite, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:25
segments: Thus speaketh Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, saying, Because thou hast sent letters in thy name unto all the people that are at Jerusalem, and to Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah the priest, and to all the priests, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:26
segments: Jehovah hath made thee priest in the stead of Jehoiada the priest, that there should be officers [in] the house of Jehovah, over every madman and self-made prophet, that thou shouldest put him in the stocks and in the shackles.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:27
segments: And now, why hast thou not reproved Jeremiah of Anathoth, who maketh himself a prophet to you?

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:28
segments: Forasmuch as he hath sent unto us in Babylon, saying, It will be long; build houses, and dwell [in them], and plant gardens, and eat the fruit of them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:29
segments: --And Zephaniah the priest read this letter in the ears of the prophet Jeremiah.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:30
segments: And the word of Jehovah came unto Jeremiah, saying,

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:31
segments: Send to all them of the captivity, saying, Thus saith Jehovah concerning Shemaiah the Nehelamite: Because that Shemaiah hath prophesied unto you, and I sent him not, and he hath caused you to trust in falsehood;

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:32
segments: therefore thus saith Jehovah: Behold, I will punish Shemaiah the Nehelamite, and his seed: he shall not have a man to dwell among this people; neither shall he see the good that I will do for my people, saith Jehovah; because he hath spoken revolt against Jehovah.
